reviews.text: Love the facility and owners !! Will be bringing my pup back ☺️

My Lola girl loves coming here for daycare ! They always send me pictures on how she’s doing and how much she loves the outdoor play area . This was her when I picked her up after pool Tuesday haha ❤️❤️ 10/10 recommend this place !
Great place, we take our German Shepard Husky, Luna, all the time. Super friendly staff and super helpful hours!

I took a tour. The staff was nice and the facility was very clean. They have huge outdoor yards for the dogs and many yards to separate them if necessary. Of course, the big dogs and little dogs are already separated. Overall, I had a really good impression of this place.

We absolutely love this place and wouldn’t leave our dogs anywhere else! We have three dogs, Bentley, Shepard, and Leonard, and the staff knows all of them by name and is always so kind and welcoming when we arrive.

The facility is incredible, with huge outdoor and indoor play areas. One of our favorite things is that all three of our dogs can stay together in the same kennel suite, since they’re used to being together at home.

The first time we dropped them off, the staff did a temperament test and actually gave us feedback on each dog, which we really appreciated. They also have plenty of add-ons like treats, baths, and other options to make their stay even better.

You can tell the staff genuinely cares about the dogs they take care of. We always feel comfortable leaving Bentley, Shep, and Leonard here and highly recommend them!!

We absolutely love boarding our three dogs here! We always feel comfortable leaving them knowing they’re in great hands, and the boys are always so excited to be there. One of my favorite things is that the staff actually knows each of our dogs by name and remembers their individual personalities — it makes such a difference and feels so much more personal than a typical boarding facility. With three dogs, finding somewhere we genuinely trust is huge for us. We’re so grateful for how well they take care of our boys and would absolutely recommend them!
Amazing staff, and huge indoor, and outdoor play space. I will definitely recommend to anyone who is looking for an away from home place for their fur family. My dog Kage loves going.
Awesome clean facility and friendly staff

Great place for dog daycare! My baby Asher loves being there and is always excited when we arrive. The staff treats the pets very well and genuinely cares about them. They have plenty of space for the dogs to play, exercise, and socialize throughout the day. It gives me peace of mind knowing Asher is in a safe, fun, and caring environment. I highly recommend this place to any pet parent looking for a trustworthy daycare for their furry friend 😊
Excellent service! Highly recommend, our dog is the happiest here!
Awesome service great staff highly recommend

Incredible experience! The staff is super professional and they treated my dog ​​Bruno wonderfully. They sent me photos every day with reports on how much he ate, who he played with, and how he spent his time. Highly recommended!
The staff is very friendly and patient, the facilities are HUGE, everything is top quality, the place is amazing, I'm so glad I found them, thank you Dallas Dog Daycare

Incredible! This is a BIG place- indoor and outdoor. Lots of space, staff and care.
The owners purchased this place 6-8 months ago, and the improvements are impressive.
Astroturfing an outside (to cut down on mud), new kennels, new play spaces, ac throughout the building…. Amazing.
Oh, and reasonable pricing with packages available.  Give them a try!

Amazing place we have a great experience with both of our dogs, they have packages to make your stay more affordable. And the daycare pool days look so cute. They sent pictures every day and a very cute report

Returning customer here! Having left our fur babies in every location of the Dallas Dog Family. Our fur babies feel at home every single time! The staff are always the nices and it gives me piece of mind to leave them whenever we travel or even for daycare during the week! I would 100% recommend them to our friends and family.
My dog is not social an even so this place feels like a Paradise to him, love the attention the had
Our little Chihuahua Bolillo is the happiest playing in this game, Thanks for take care of him these ten days!

I have boarded with Dallas Dog and their other locations for years, I trust them with my babies blindly. My biggest testament is that every time we drop off, my dogs get EXCITED and run in without looking back. If that doesn’t tell you what a great place this is, I don’t know what will! Highly recommend, they have so much outdoor space, it’s amazing!
This is the best dog boarding in Dallas. They are safe, clean, and took great care of our baby. Great option for long term boarding.

Just amazing the improvements that have been made to this facility! I have had the pleasure of meeting ownership and you could not ask for nicer more understanding people and in tune with your dogs needs.
Owner and management team are awesome! We have always had a great experience boarding our dog
Won’t take my dog anywhere else!
Tons of outdoor and indoor space for the dogs to play! The staff are very helpful and know and care about every dog that visits them.
Amazing facility 🍃✨wonderful staff 💕🎉 …
